neighbourhoods.title: Neighbourhoods
neighbourhoods.description: StreetEasy-style neighbourhood slugs, e.g. williamsburg, east-village, long-island-city. Each becomes its own Apartments.com search (/williamsburg-brooklyn-ny/). A slug that already ends in -ny is used as the Apartments.com location as-is. Overrides borough.

borough.title: Borough
borough.description: Used when no neighbourhoods are given. Leave empty for all of NYC.

maxPrice.title: Max price (USD/month)
maxPrice.description: Maximum monthly rent. Leave empty for no limit.

minBeds.title: Min bedrooms
minBeds.description: Minimum bedrooms (0 = studio). Leave empty for any.

maxItems.title: Max rows
maxItems.description: Stop after this many dataset rows in total (a building with several bed types counts once per bed type).

maxPages.title: Max pages per search
maxPages.description: Apartments.com shows about 40 properties per page and stops at 28 pages.

searchUrls.title: Search URLs (advanced)
searchUrls.description: Full Apartments.com search URLs, e.g. https://www.apartments.com/williamsburg-brooklyn-ny/min-1-bedrooms-under-4500/. When given, the fields above are ignored.

proxyCountry.title: Residential proxy country
proxyCountry.description: Two-letter country code for the residential proxy.

blockScripts.title: Block all scripts
blockScripts.description: Load only the server-rendered HTML, no JavaScript (much less proxy traffic). Turn off if Apartments.com (Akamai) starts blocking.

debug.title: Debug dump
debug.description: Save page HTML to the key-value store (for development).
